analysis:
The only changed file is CHANGELOG.md, a documentation file that adds a v0.10.8 candidate section (head lines 11-333) and rewrites the former v0.10.7 candidate header to published. No executable source, workflow, or policy file is in this batch, so the changelog's claims about provider behavior were not checked against code.

Security-relevant claims the next pass should check against the real source:
- Rollout notes (lines 17-20) say a pair with mismatched builds fails closed, and that updates install on both Macs or neither.
- Line 22 says LaunchServices is refreshed and Apple is asked again after an `is_supported_false` answer. This touches the App Attest provider-connection-control path (A-015, A-016, TB-011, T-057). The claim is that it does not change proof verification or authorization. That needs confirmation in code.
- Lines 33-34 say an attestation cut off by a disconnect or stop is kept for up to 30 seconds and sent on the next connection. This could affect the T-053 binding of proofs to a connection and the stale-authorization boundary. It needs source review that the kept proof is still bound to the current key, connection, and expiry, and is not replayed across accounts.
- Lines 170-174 describe clearing file-cache pages for model weight files and say file contents are never changed. A-004 and T-012 are the relevant threat IDs.
- Lines 308 and 312 describe uninstall and installer behavior, covered by TB-013 and T-061. They say uninstall revokes the account token only where the coordinator confirms, deletes only within Darkbloom folders, and refuses under sudo.
- Lines 325-329 describe the updater record, rollback, and quarantine behavior, covered by T-043.
- Line 27 says registration, scripts and `ClusterPublicModels` are unchanged.
- Lines 307-315 and 319 describe the release-page content and CI cache changes. CI caching and the token no longer persisting in `.git/config` are not threat-model assets.

No finding is raised because prose alone cannot establish a regression. The threat model may need a note on the new keep-cut-off-attestation behavior (lines 33-34) if the code change confirms it. needs_deeper_review is true only because the underlying source changes were not supplied.
